_comment_1: Phantom MCP — config entry for Jan.ai. In Jan, go to Settings → MCP Servers → Add Server, then paste the 'mcpServers' block below.
_comment_2: Jan.ai speaks the same OpenAI-compatible API as LM Studio but on port 1337. server_v2.py auto-detects this — no extra flags needed.
_comment_cwd: IMPORTANT: set 'cwd' to the absolute path of your phantom-mcp folder on this machine. Example: C:\phantom-mcp
_comment_python: Jan runs server_v2.py as a child process. Use 'py -3.11' on Windows (matches your existing setup) or 'python3' on Mac/Linux.

rationale: Phantom auto-detects Jan.ai on port 1337 and sizes its token budget to your loaded model's context window.
If Jan is running on a non-standard port, set the env var PHANTOM_HOST_URL in the entry below, e.g. 'PHANTOM_HOST_URL': 'http://localhost:9999/v1'.
Screenshots default to ~2.5k tokens (downscaled JPEG). desktop_screenshot(hires=true) is much heavier — only use when you need to read fine text.
If you have a small-context model (4k-8k), phantom will trim outputs more aggressively. Run memory_compact periodically.

_custom_port_example._note: Only needed if Jan.ai is on a non-default port. Add PHANTOM_HOST_URL to the env block.

_run_alongside_other_mcp_servers: Phantom is self-contained — no other MCP server is required.
If you run a second MCP server alongside it in Jan, that is fine: Jan talks to each over its own stdio pipe.
Tool names are namespaced (desktop_*, memory_*, file_*, window_*, process_*, shell_*, agent_*) so the model routes cleanly even with multiple servers loaded.
